version.note: Original solo-piano work; the performing edition and any unnotated changes are not identified. The score used for commentary is not asserted to be the copy used at the session.

performers.note: The source item, reissue register and Victor matrix record agree on the pianist.

date.note: The filename date is independently corroborated by the reissue register and DAHR’s approved take; it is not an upload or CD release date.

place.value: Camden, New Jersey, Church Building Laboratory
place.note: DAHR explicitly names the Church Bldg. Laboratory for the approved take.

label.note: Victor identifies the original commercial issue; the uploader identifies the later RCA/BMG CD set as its immediate source.

catalogue.note: The Victor number and CD set are separately documented. The physical disc transferred for the 1992 mastering is not identified.

matrixTakeSides.note: DAHR documents this approved matrix/take and the RCA booklet names it for the reissued track. Its linkage to the current digital file follows the uploader’s stated CD provenance and matching work/date, not an independent waveform or run-out comparison.

credits.value: John Pfeiffer, reissue producer; Ward Marston, disc-to-DAT transfer; André Gauthier, remastering supervisor; Anthony Salvatore, remastering engineer
credits.note: These are the original 1992 set’s credits. Their connection to the current access file follows the uploader’s identification of that set; the later ripper/uploader is not named as a mastering engineer.

date.note: The set was issued in 1992, but the date of the disc-to-DAT transfer and the later CD extraction are not stated. The Archive upload occurred in 2025 and is not a transfer-session date.

processing.value: Disc-to-DAT transfer, followed by digital remastering at BMG/RCA Studios, New York City; Archive derives its VBR MP3 from an uploaded WAV.
processing.note: The booklet says surface imperfections were reduced without radical removal of all surface noise. It does not give equalisation, pitch-correction, noise-reduction or editing settings. No such settings are inferred from the audio analysis.

digital.format: VBR MP3 access derivative; uploaded source identified as WAV from a 1992 CD reissue of an acoustic Victor disc

composition.value: Underlying composition is out of copyright where the ordinary life-plus-70 term applies.
composition.note: Rachmaninoff died in 1943. This is a territorial term calculation, not worldwide clearance or a statement about an unidentified modern performing edition.

recording.value: Internet Archive applies Public Domain Mark 1.0 to the audio; the underlying performance is a historic Victor commercial issue from the pre-1926 period.
recording.note: Eligibility is based on the historic issued sound recording, not merely on the age of the composition or the 1992 reissue date. DAHR and the booklet document the early Victor issue and take; the precise first-publication day is not established here. The 1992 booklet retains an all-rights-reserved notice for the reissue. No claim is made that its text, artwork or compilation is public domain, or that an unidentified new creative contribution to the transfer has independent clearance worldwide.

rights.creditLine: Sergei Rachmaninoff, piano — Victor 74628, matrix C-23984-4. Digital source: RCA/BMG Complete Recordings (1992), CD 10, via Internet Archive; Public Domain Mark 1.0 is the item’s recording-rights statement.
